Generic AffineScalarMixture accepts covariance matrices symmetric within 1e-12 but passes each input directly to Cholesky rather than symmetrizing. The tested actual covariances are constructed symmetrically and the supplied-bank result passes. For general callers with tolerated tiny asymmetry, either symmetrize or require exact/stricter symmetry to make “exact” API semantics unambiguous.

mathematical_review.conditioning: The implementation uses Cholesky whitening and a centered residual projection rather than subtracting large quadratic forms. It rejects nonfinite whitened values, nonpositive scalar precision, unsupported base range and overflowed mean quadratics. Actual-bank comparisons at 16 supplied means through ±20 passed at tight tolerances. This is evidence for the supplied bank/range, not all ill-conditioned covariance banks or unbounded means.
mathematical_review.equivalence: For each component C_s=L_s L_s^T, let u_s=L_s^-1 t and v_s=L_s^-1(y-d). Then A_s=u_s^T u_s, m_s=u_s^T v_s/A_s, K_s=||v_s-u_s m_s||^2, and N_s=−1/2[n log(2π)+2 sum(log diag L_s)]. Thus log N(y;d+tμ,C_s)=N_s−K_s/2−A_s(μ−m_s)^2/2. The implementation uses base_s=log w_s+N_s−K_s/2 and logsumexp across unchanged component weights. Its derivative is the responsibility weighted sum of −A_s(μ−m_s), equal to the directional derivative t^T∇_mean of the original vector mixture.
mathematical_review.weights_and_constants: Original normalized nonnegative weights are used unchanged (and byte-identical to source bank). Full 6D Gaussian normalizer and component-specific residual evidence K_s remain in base_s; the negative control that replaces these with normalized 1D Gaussian constants changes the −1-to-1 log-likelihood contrast by 0.0145732. Zero-weight handling is separately exercised in invented data.
